method: Reviewed the whole lesson against current official LangChain tool-schema and OpenAI Agents SDK runner/tracing documentation. Executed the complete lesson Python fence in Python 3.10 with LangChain 0.3.7, langchain-core 0.3.63 and Pydantic 2.9.2, and separately verified the install command plus exact output in a fresh Python 3.10 virtual environment; compared stdout byte-for-byte with the adjacent output fence. The verifier also compiles the code and checks bounded taxonomy, observability and historical-result wording. The code only constructs local tool schemas; no model, provider or network call is made.

observations.model: local LangChain schema construction; no model invocation

limitations: The historical Chapter 4 enum 3/3 versus free-string 0/3 measurements still lack per-call requests, responses and a replayable scorer; this review does not reproduce them or establish a general model-quality effect.

The local probe verifies only the documented schema-generation behavior for the pinned package versions and these two function signatures. It does not evaluate tool selection, provider behavior, framework performance, observability completeness or production security.
Current LangChain and OpenAI SDK documentation can change; the explicitly pinned local example is scoped to its listed versions, while other versions and providers require their own contract checks.
